recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a man looking downward, set against a deep red, textured background. The subject's skin is highly reflective, emphasizing muscular definition. Centralized typography features a large, white, hand-drawn distressed script layered over the chest, with a smaller, clean sans-serif subtitle below.
coreVisualRelationships: The downward gaze creates a mood of introspection and gravity.
The white distressed lettering pops against the dark, oily skin tones.
The deep red background provides a warm, intense atmosphere that complements the skin's highlights.
The central placement of the subject and text creates a strong vertical axis.
coreInvariants: High-gloss skin texture with sharp specular highlights.
Monochromatic red background with subtle vertical light streaks.
Distressed, 'scratched-in' aesthetic for the primary display text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered, filling the frame from the waist up, with the head tilted down.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white distressed lettering positioned centrally on the subject's chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top with the subject's forehead, moves down the bridge of the nose to the central text, then settles on the clasped hands at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject dominates the frame, with the red background acting as a tight atmospheric envelope.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep crimson and ruby red (background and shadows).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds; high value contrast between the white text and the dark skin/background.

letterConstructionRules: Glyphs appear scratched or painted with a dry brush.
Irregular, jagged edges with internal voids.
Variable stroke width with a 'street art' or 'grunge' feel.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' has a crossbar that extends beyond the vertical stems.
The 'N' features a sharp, aggressive diagonal stroke.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between organic, chaotic display text and rigid, spaced-out geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Distressed texture of the main text
avoid: Clean, corporate fonts for the main title
Bright colors for the text other than white/black

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, scratched-in aesthetic of the display text.
Matches the clean, extended look of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A dramatic, low-key studio portrait of a Black man looking down, shirtless, with highly reflective, oiled skin. Lighting should be high-contrast (chiaroscuro) with sharp highlights on the shoulders and forehead. The background is a dark, textured crimson red with vertical light falloff.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, distressed hand-drawn title across the chest area. Below it, add a small, black, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif subtitle. Ensure the white text has a subtle grit to match the 'scratched' style.

verificationChecks: Is the skin texture highly reflective?
Is the background a deep, moody red?
Is the primary text sufficiently distressed and white?
Is the subtitle widely tracked and black?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the typography
Amount of specular highlight on the skin
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Any existing brand logos or legal markers

mustAchieve: Visceral, gritty texture in the type
avoid: Clean, digital-looking fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the distress.
Check that the red background doesn't overpower the subject.
Verify the skin highlights look wet or oily, not just bright.
Confirm the vertical alignment of all elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast, low-key portrait with a textured red backdrop and layered, distressed typography to create an intense, personal visual narrative.
